Arvog & Augmont

A Partnership for Instant Gold Loans 

Finkurve has entered into an arrangement with Augmont Goldtech Private Limited wherein Augmont shall provide its ‘Augmont Gold For All’ platform exclusively to Arvog (Finkurve Financial Services Limited) to facilitate its gold loan business.

 

Augmont, with the help of its NBFC partner 'Arvog' and a strong network of 100+ branches, is able to offer instant gold loans to the masses at the lowest interest rates. Augmont is trusted by 4.2+ crore customers, 180+ partner brands, and 4900+ jewellers and Partners.

 

Ketan Kothari is the quintessential innovator spearheading new product development at Augmont. He has been involved in the launch of India's first structured product in the commodities market—RSBL Optionally Convertible Debentures and 'Bullion++', which is primarily targeted at HNIs and provides a dual income advantage.
